content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store with no-KYC payments enables creators to sell ebooks, courses, and templates seamlessly without relying on traditional payment processors. This architecture offers a sovereign commerce stack that provides creators with the tools they need to sell directly to their audience. By implementing crypto payment systems like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction, creators can save substantial amounts compared to platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This approach not only enhances profitability but also ensures that creators maintain complete ownership of their data and sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core infrastructure consists of several components working together. Hosting is set up using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while backend logic is managed with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be efficiently handled with Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring that all data is easily accessible. For file delivery, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is used to provide quick access to digital products. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly for automatic crypto payment processing, allowing transactions in over 300 cryptocurrencies without requiring KYC verification, thus providing a truly decentralized and user-friendly experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically crafted for digital creators in countries where traditional payment platforms are either unavailable or overly restrictive. It serves authors, course creators, graphic designers, and other digital product sellers who wish to avoid high fees and cumbersome compliance processes. With this architecture, creators can focus on what they do best—creating and selling their products—while enjoying the benefits of low transaction costs and ownership of their business infrastructure. By choosing this path, they can reach global markets with ease and confidence.
Save substantial fees by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To build a successful digital product store without KYC payments, you need a combination of tools. Start with a hosting platform like GitHub Pages for a reliable storefront. Use Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, ensuring quick responses to customer actions. Supabase or Google Sheets will manage your orders efficiently. File delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, providing instant access to purchased downloads. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for a seamless payment experience, allowing customers to pay with cryptocurrencies. Each component is designed to work together smoothly, ensuring a hassle-free experience for both creators and buyers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To set up your digital product store, start by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up your order and customer management system with Supabase or Google Sheets. Then, choose Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file hosting to ensure your digital products are instantly accessible. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to enable crypto transactions with low fees. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a digital product store built on sovereign infrastructure. This solution leverages crypto payments via NOWPayments, allowing you to keep more of your earnings. Instead of relying on platforms that charge high fees, you can maintain control over your sales and customer data while benefiting from lower transaction costs.
Maintain complete ownership of your digital products and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Crypto payments eliminate the need for KYC, ensuring privacy for both you and your customers. Additionally, transaction fees are significantly lower, allowing you to retain more profit.

By using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file hosting, you can automate product delivery. Integrating your order management system with these tools ensures customers receive their purchases instantly.
